title: Agentic Returns Triage with a Human in the Loop: Tool-Calling Language-Model Architecture, Configuration-Consistency Screening and Deferral Policy for OEM Hardware Intake
content: Every returned unit of enterprise networking hardware is triaged at intake: is it what the return authorization says, what condition is it in, where should it go. At the OEM whose platform I built, a technician answers those from a serial scan, a declared configuration, a note and photographs, about 250 times a day. This paper presents a Returns Triage Agent — a tool-calling language-model orchestrator with five typed tools — and a policy layer that routes a unit automatically when calibrated confidence clears a threshold and otherwise defers it to a reviewer with an evidence pack. Because the model's production evaluation is pending, its components are evaluated on synthetic data calibrated to the intake process. A supervised inconsistency scorer reaches F1 0.93 against 0.72 for hard rules, lifting recall on module swaps from 3% to 72% and on licence tampering from 0% to 100%. A calibrated note classifier routes 65% of units automatically at 97% accuracy at threshold 0.80. A queue simulation shows three reviewers sustain a threshold of 0.85 with a 95th-percentile wait under an hour, saturating above 0.90. The paper closes with the pre-registered protocol under which the language model is evaluated before it may act.
